justification: The castle has many staircases that change, and a man who rushes to meet them merely trips earlier. Jayden Daniels has already kicked off Thursday in Washington, and I would not move him even if I wished to, so let that settle the one piece that truly needed settling. For the rest: Jonathan Taylor, Olave, Washington, and Warren owe me nothing and I ask nothing further of them. Emanuel Wilson returned a bagel last week, and the garden does not pull up a seedling for bearing no fruit on a single cold Sunday — he has a part yet to play, and it is not this column that decides when. I note Rodriguez and Pickens and Garrett Wilson on my bench all wearing "Questionable" like it is a diagnosis rather than a Thursday guess; I read those tags as omens to leave well enough alone, not summonses to act. Denver has no game this week and no understudy behind it either, so it starts regardless, the way one plants a tree knowing some years it gives no shade. Nothing here is urgent. That is rather the point.
